cards.def: the whole physical form of a person or an animal
cards.ex: Swimming is good for your whole body.
cards.exVn: Bơi lội tốt cho toàn bộ cơ thể của bạn.

cards.def: the top part of the body, where the eyes, ears, nose and mouth are
cards.ex: Always wear a helmet to protect your head.
cards.exVn: Hãy luôn đội mũ bảo hiểm để bảo vệ đầu của bạn.

cards.def: one of the two parts of the face that you see with
cards.ex: My eyes hurt after using the computer all day.
cards.exVn: Mắt tôi bị đau sau khi dùng máy tính cả ngày.

cards.def: one of the two parts on the sides of the head that you hear with
cards.ex: Loud music can hurt your ears.
cards.exVn: Nhạc to có thể làm hại tai của bạn.

cards.def: the part of the face that you use for eating and speaking
cards.ex: Please open your mouth so the doctor can look inside.
cards.exVn: Vui lòng há miệng để bác sĩ có thể nhìn vào bên trong.

cards.def: one of the hard white things in your mouth that you use for biting and eating
cards.ex: I brush my teeth twice a day.
cards.exVn: Tôi đánh răng hai lần một ngày.

cards.def: one of the two long parts of the body between the shoulder and the hand
cards.ex: He broke his arm when he fell off his bike.
cards.exVn: Anh ấy bị gãy tay khi ngã xe đạp.

cards.def: the part of the body at the end of the arm, with four fingers and a thumb
cards.ex: Wash your hands before you eat.
cards.exVn: Hãy rửa tay trước khi ăn.

cards.def: one of the long parts of the body that you use for walking and standing
cards.ex: My legs were tired after the long walk.
cards.exVn: Chân tôi mỏi sau chuyến đi bộ dài.

cards.def: the part of the body at the end of the leg that you stand on
cards.ex: I hurt my foot while playing football.
cards.exVn: Tôi bị đau chân khi đang chơi bóng đá.

cards.vn: khỏe mạnh; tốt cho sức khỏe
cards.def: strong and not ill; good for your body
cards.ex: Eating fruit and vegetables helps you stay healthy.
cards.exVn: Ăn trái cây và rau giúp bạn luôn khỏe mạnh.

cards.def: not feeling well; suffering from a disease
cards.ex: I didn't go to school yesterday because I was ill.
cards.exVn: Hôm qua tôi không đi học vì bị ốm.

cards.def: a pain in your head
cards.ex: I often get a headache when I don't sleep enough.
cards.exVn: Tôi thường bị đau đầu khi ngủ không đủ giấc.

cards.def: a pain in your stomach
cards.ex: She had a stomach ache after eating too much ice cream.
cards.exVn: Cô ấy bị đau bụng sau khi ăn quá nhiều kem.

cards.def: a pain in one of your teeth
cards.ex: I have a toothache, so I need to see a dentist.
cards.exVn: Tôi bị đau răng nên cần đi khám nha sĩ.

cards.def: an illness that makes you push air out of your throat with a sudden loud noise
cards.ex: My little brother has a bad cough this week.
cards.exVn: Tuần này em trai tôi bị ho nặng.

cards.def: a common illness that makes you sneeze and gives you a sore throat
cards.ex: I caught a cold after walking in the rain.
cards.exVn: Tôi bị cảm lạnh sau khi đi bộ dưới mưa.

cards.def: a pain in your throat, often when you have a cold
cards.ex: I have a sore throat, so it is hard to speak.
cards.exVn: Tôi bị đau họng nên nói chuyện rất khó.

cards.def: a substance that you take to treat an illness
cards.ex: Take this medicine three times a day after meals.
cards.exVn: Hãy uống thuốc này ba lần một ngày sau bữa ăn.

cards.def: a small hard piece of medicine that you swallow
cards.ex: The doctor told me to take two pills before bed.
cards.exVn: Bác sĩ bảo tôi uống hai viên thuốc trước khi đi ngủ.

cards.def: an arrangement to see someone, such as a doctor, at a particular time
cards.ex: I made an appointment with the doctor for Monday morning.
cards.exVn: Tôi đã đặt lịch hẹn với bác sĩ vào sáng thứ Hai.

cards.def: the part of the body between the head and the shoulders
cards.ex: Looking at your phone for too long can hurt your neck.
cards.exVn: Nhìn điện thoại quá lâu có thể làm bạn đau cổ.

cards.def: one of the two parts of the body between the neck and the top of the arms
cards.ex: My shoulders hurt after carrying a heavy bag.
cards.exVn: Vai tôi bị đau sau khi mang một chiếc túi nặng.

cards.def: the organ in your chest that pushes blood around your body
cards.ex: Regular exercise is good for your heart.
cards.exVn: Tập thể dục đều đặn tốt cho tim của bạn.

cards.vn: khỏe mạnh, cân đối (nhờ tập luyện)
cards.def: healthy and strong, especially because you exercise regularly
cards.ex: My father goes cycling every morning to stay fit.
cards.exVn: Bố tôi đạp xe mỗi sáng để giữ dáng khỏe mạnh.
